text:
ITEM 1 | Mounded portion of small brown granular grains, dark reddish-brown to tan, with scattered darker red-brown beans/kidney-like pieces and a few green flecks, moist and clumped, slightly glossy, roughly 9 cm across and 2.5 cm high, sits upper-left of plate | 210
ITEM 2 | Pale off-white creamy baked mass with browned golden edges, containing chunks of cream-colored pieces and whole light beans, mixed with dark green leafy shreds, moist and binding together, roughly 8 cm by 6 cm and 2 cm high, sits upper-right next to the grain mound | 180
ITEM 3 | Sliced zucchini in thin wedges and half-moons with bright green skin and pale yellow-green flesh, glossy and moist with slight translucence, some pieces lightly charred or cooked soft, roughly 10 cm by 7 cm spread and 1 cm high, lower-left of plate | 120
ITEM 4 | Fresh dark green herb leaves and stems, flat-leaf style, bright green and matte, a small cluster about 4 cm by 3 cm, lying atop the zucchini near center-bottom | 8
ITEM 5 | Sliced carrot rounds and half-rounds, bright orange with slightly darker caramelized edges and faint roasting marks, glossy, firm and holding shape, roughly 9 cm by 6 cm spread and 1.2 cm high, lower-right of plate, partially overlapping a few orange carrot pieces | 130
ITEM 6 | Small scattered white crumbles, soft and matte, a few pieces about 0.5 cm, sitting on the zucchini and carrots | 5
